facts: The task of machine translation (MT) evaluation is closely related to the task of sentence-level semantic equivalence classification.
The paper investigates the utility of applying standard MT evaluation methods to building classifiers to predict semantic equivalence and entailment.
BLEU is a standard MT evaluation method.
NIST is a standard MT evaluation method.
WER is a standard MT evaluation method.
PER is a standard MT evaluation method.
The paper introduces a novel classification method based on PER.
The novel classification method based on PER leverages part of speech information.
The part of speech information is of the words contributing to the word matches in the sentence.
The part of speech information is of the words contributing to the word non-matches in the sentence.
MT evaluation techniques are able to produce useful features for paraphrase classification.
MT evaluation techniques are able to produce useful features for entailment to a lesser extent.
The novel classification method based on PER gives a substantial improvement in paraphrase classification accuracy over all of the other models used in the experiments.
